name: EGLOOK-LORDS-presence-table-moved
old: export const EG_LORD_PRESENCE = Object.freeze({ lord: 1.6, valkynaz: 1.8, champion: 1.4 });
new: export const EG_LORD_PRESENCE = Object.freeze({ lord: 1.6, valkynaz: 1.6, champion: 1.4 });

name: EGLOOK-LORDS-adds-grown
old: return { ...L, presence: 1, drawn: L.scale, hover: (b.fl & EG_FL.fly) !== 0 ? L.hover : Math.min(L.hover, 0.9) };

name: EGLOOK-LORDS-quad-at-the-body
old:
w = sz.w * look.drawn,
      h = sz.h * look.drawn; // EG-LOOK (section 9): the sprite at its presence
new:
w = sz.w * look.scale,
      h = sz.h * look.scale; // EG-LOOK (section 9): the sprite at its presence

name: EGLOOK-LORDS-shadow-kept
old: if (look.presence > 1) d.batch.noShadow = true; // EG-LOOK: OW-BIG's law - a grown figure casts no giant's shadow (render/shadowPass.js)
new: if (look.presence > 2) d.batch.noShadow = true; // EG-LOOK: OW-BIG's law - a grown figure casts no giant's shadow (render/shadowPass.js)

name: EGLOOK-LORDS-sphere-at-the-body
new: if (d.batch.bounds) d.batch.bounds[3] = Math.hypot(sz.w * look.scale, sz.h * look.scale) * 0.5;

name: EGLOOK-LORDS-bob-at-the-bodys
old:
(look.hover > 0
        ? ('aloft' in act ? act.aloft : 1) * (look.hover + HOVER_BOB_M * look.presence * Math.sin(t / 260 + b.i))
        : 0); // EG-LOOK: a flyer's hover and bob its drawn ones; EG-FALL: dropping out of them as it falls
new: (look.hover > 0 ? ('aloft' in act ? act.aloft : 1) * (look.hover + HOVER_BOB_M * Math.sin(t / 260 + b.i)) : 0); // EG-LOOK: a flyer's hover and bob its drawn ones; EG-FALL: dropping out of them as it falls

name: EGLOOK-LORDS-stale-head-kept
old:
d.top = NaN;
    if (b.fellAt > 0 && b.role === EG_ROLE.lord) lordFall.see(b, t, look, centre); // EG-FALL: its fall's beats, its dying glow, its body left - its pictures or none
new: if (b.fellAt > 0 && b.role === EG_ROLE.lord) lordFall.see(b, t, look, centre); // EG-FALL: its fall's beats, its dying glow, its body left - its pictures or none

name: EGLOOK-LORDS-numerals-at-the-body
old: const at = egScreenAt(vp, egGivenAt(b, centre, tg, b.role === EG_ROLE.lord ? drawn.get(i)?.top : NaN)); // EG-LOOK (section 9): over a lord's drawn head
new: const at = egScreenAt(vp, egGivenAt(b, centre, tg, NaN)); // EG-LOOK (section 9): over a lord's drawn head

name: EGLOOK-LORDS-laws-height-swapped
old: : centre[1] + egBodyHeight(b, t) + (b.role === EG_ROLE.lord ? EG_GIVEN_UP_LORD_M : EG_GIVEN_UP_M);
new: : centre[1] + egBodyHeight(b, t) + (b.role === EG_ROLE.lord ? EG_GIVEN_UP_M : EG_GIVEN_UP_LORD_M);
